findings.quote: The microreactor was capped with a teflon pressure cap and placed into pre-heated aluminum block at 80 oC.
findings.message: The standalone HeatChill step does not identify its target and risks treating aluminum-block preheating as a separate heating of the reaction. The subsequent step already captures the reaction heating. Preserve block preheating and physical placement as unmapped details rather than an untargeted HeatChill step.
The GC/MS completion check before solvent removal is omitted. Preserve it as an unmapped action because the allowed operations do not represent analytical monitoring.

findings.quote: chromatographic separation with silica gel (25 % ethyl acetate in hexane as eluent)
findings.message: The purification evidence retains the conditions, but the operational representation only specifies chromatography. Preserve the silica-gel stationary phase and eluent composition explicitly as unmapped details because the closed Purify schema cannot encode them.

value.evidence: placed into pre-heated aluminum block at 80 oC
value.reason: The aluminum block was preheated, and the microreactor was physically placed into it. These apparatus-preparation and placement details are not represented by the allowed vessel-based operations; reaction heating is retained in the HeatChill step.
Completion was assessed by GC/MS before THF removal; analytical monitoring is not represented by an allowed operation.
